gloss: to stop by, to drop in, to visit briefly

definitions.gloss: to stop by, to drop in
definitions.explanation: To visit a place briefly, usually on the way to somewhere else.
To make a short, casual visit.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}りにコンビニに{立|た}ち{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: I stopped by the convenience store on my way home.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}くにお{越|こ}しの{際|さい}は、ぜひお{立|た}ち{寄|よ}りください。
examples.english: Please drop by when you're in the area.

examples.japanese: {観光|かんこう}のついでに{有名|ゆうめい}な{神社|じんじゃ}に{立|た}ち{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: I stopped by a famous shrine while sightseeing.

notes:
{立|た}ち{寄|よ}る is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to stop by or drop in.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {立|た}つ (to stand) + {寄|よ}る (to approach) → to stop and approach

ASPECT (ている):
{立|た}ち{寄|よ}っている indicates being at a place one has stopped by.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～に{立|た}ち{寄|よ}る (stop by~)
- {帰|かえ}りに{立|た}ち{寄|よ}る (stop by on the way home)
- ついでに{立|た}ち{寄|よ}る (stop by while you're at it)
- お{立|た}ち{寄|よ}りください (please stop by - polite)

RELATED NOUN:
- {立|た}ち{寄|よ}り: a stop, stopover; {立|た}ち{寄|よ}り{先|さき} = place one stops by

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {寄|よ}る: to stop by (simpler, more casual)
- {訪|たず}ねる: to visit (more formal, planned)

[Register: Neutral]
